title: Accountable terminates verification services for MainStreet
description: Accountable ended its service relationship with MainStreet after stating that MainStreet did not meet its verification standards, removing the previously available public reserve-verification path.
notes: This establishes loss of public verification visibility, not a confirmed reserve deficit or insolvency.

title: msUSD suffers severe market depeg
description: msUSD traded materially below its intended one-dollar peg after the verification-provider termination, with reporting placing the intraday low near nine cents.
notes: A rebound from the low is not treated as sustainable peg recovery. Market price is distinct from verified direct-redemption value.

title: JPYSC begins restricted account-internal distribution
description: JPYSC launched through SBI VC Trade as a trust-issued Japanese-yen stablecoin. Initial use was limited to eligible platform accounts, with external-wallet transfer and public-chain circulation unavailable.
notes: Launch is recorded separately from future external-transfer, public-chain, lending, and additional-network milestones.

title: SBI VC Trade begins RLUSD handling in Japan
description: SBI VC Trade began handling RLUSD in Japan as a Type 4 electronic payment instrument, adding a regulated Japanese distribution and access route without changing RLUSD's global launch date or active status.
notes: This is a regional distribution event, not a new global launch and not a change to the USD peg reference.
